aboutStory:
Unlike the original Monaco guide — built the night before an actual visit and beta tested on the circuit itself — this Singapore guide was researched remotely, not walked in person.

The racing line comes from public GPS data and the historical facts are sourced from race reports and Wikipedia, but corner positions are still being validated against the real track — the Marina Bay circuit changed significantly in 2023, and getting the numbering right took real care.

Treat it as a work in progress rather than ground truth, and if you walk it yourself, corrections and reports are very welcome.
helpSubtitle: Fan-made walking guide — S/F line + all 19 corners of the Marina Bay Street Circuit
helpOfflineNote: After first load, the app and map tiles work fully offline. This makes it useful as a general Singapore GPS map even when roaming doesn't work.
quirkBody: Marina Bay's layout changed substantially in 2023 — a technical waterfront section was demolished and replaced with a straight, cutting the corner count from 23 to 19. Corner positions in this app are still being validated against the current track — treat exact placements as provisional for now.
welcomeSub: Walk all 19 corners of the Marina Bay Street Circuit, home of F1's first night race.
welcomeSteps: Start at the S/F marker beside the Singapore Flyer — that's where the race starts and ends each lap.
Enable GPS and the app follows you — auto-advancing to the next corner as you approach. Orange markers mean you're close. Use Auto to toggle this.
Works offline — once loaded, the map and app work without internet. Useful as a general Singapore GPS map if roaming doesn't work.
Tap Help anytime for full details on all features.
